tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You recently attended your university's choir concert and had a great experience. However, you left your favorite jacket behind. You need to contact the university's lost and found department. Write an email to the lost and found manager, Ms. Davis.
bullets: Explain when and where you left your jacket.
Suggest a solution for the issue.
tasks.subject: Lost Jacket Inquiry
